page.content:
Seattle chain that scaled espresso drinks into a global second-wave brand.

How Starbucks connects

  • Character: Howard Schultz — Howard Schultz expanded Starbucks on an Italian espresso-bar model.
  • Location: Seattle — Starbucks began and is still headquartered in the Seattle area.
  • Item: Espresso — Starbucks scaled espresso-and-milk drinks into a global chain menu.
  • Topic: Third wave coffee — Third wave defined itself after and against Starbucks-scale second-wave espresso.

What is Starbucks?

Starbucks, from a Pike Place store to thousands of cafés, made lattes everyday English and is the commercial node third wave defined itself against and after.

Key threads lead to Howard Schultz, Seattle, Espresso and Third wave coffee.
